systems.owner: the mayor, as officier d'état civil of the commune (articles 69-71)
systems.tiers: commune (mairie); the mayor may delegate to a mairie official, and for marriages only to a deputy or a chef d'arrondissement

note: The 1999 communes law makes the mayor civil-status officer who receives declarations of birth, marriage and death and transcribes them on the civil-status registers (art. 70); it does not say whether the registers are paper or digital, and names no digital system, so no fact. The source text stops mid-article 81.
